ko_KR.field_note: KO LOC HOLD: Check source labels, line length, alarm priority, sensor justification, censor tier, and audio timing.
ko_KR.terminal: KO LOC HOLD: Survival warnings take priority over flavor. No threat line appears without a sensor, voice, or visible source.
ko_KR.audio: KO LOC HOLD: If the player cannot act on it, keep it quiet.
ko_KR.in_game_wiki: KO LOC HOLD: Localized subtitles and audio must preserve source, timing, warning priority, and readable line length while avoiding omniscient threat spoilers.
ko_KR.external_site: KO LOC HOLD: HECTON-8 subtitles are treated as instruments: they identify who or what speaks, stay readable during pressure, and do not turn hazards into chatter.
